verdict.rationale: Temporal positions itself as an orchestration platform for AI apps and agents, so consuming MCP servers' tools is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents plugging MCP servers in as tool sources. The generic claim of orchestrating agents across 'any models, tools' and the Google ADK and Vercel AI SDK integrations are adjacent features, not a documented MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
